This repository tracks public product work; Knit's application source is maintained
privately. Before opening a pull request, please start with an issue or discussion
so maintainers can confirm that a tracker-documentation change belongs here.

- [ ] This change only modifies public tracker documentation or community configuration.
- [ ] It contains no application source, private implementation detail, credentials, logs, workspace content, or personal information.
- [ ] A related issue or discussion is linked below.
